```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)

# In setup chunk:
fig_dir <- here("outputs", "figures_05_02", "eda")
dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# In the class-distributions-data chunk:
perry_fp_files <- list.files(here("outputs"),
                              pattern = "^perry_fp_clean_.*\\.csv$",
                              full.names = TRUE)
dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

thesis_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

# Consistent dataset colors throughout
ds_colors <- c("NCSS" = "#2C7BB6", "Perry" = "#D7191C")
```

```{r load-data}
library(here)

# Load most recent NCSS pack
ncss_files <- list.files(here("outputs"),
                         pattern = "^pedon_pack_150_.*\\.csv$",
                         full.names = TRUE)
ncss_path <- ncss_files[which.max(file.mtime(ncss_files))]
ncss <- read.csv(ncss_path) %>% mutate(dataset = "NCSS")
cat("NCSS:", nrow(ncss), "pedons from", basename(ncss_path), "\n")

# Load most recent Perry pack
perry_files <- list.files(here("outputs"),
                          pattern = "^perry_pack_150_.*\\.csv$",
                          full.names = TRUE)
perry_path <- perry_files[which.max(file.mtime(perry_files))]
perry <- read.csv(perry_path) %>% mutate(dataset = "Perry")
cat("Perry:", nrow(perry), "pedons from", basename(perry_path), "\n")

# Stacked for plotting
both <- bind_rows(
  ncss %>% mutate(peiid = as.character(peiid)),
  perry %>% mutate(peiid = as.character(peiid))
) %>%
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = c("NCSS", "Perry")))


```

```{r class-distributions-data}
# Need NCSS taxonomic columns + Perry truth (from perry_fp_clean)
# Perry doesn't have these as columns in perry_pack — need to merge truth in

perry_fp_files <- list.files(here("outputs"),
                              pattern = "^perry_fp_clean_.*\\.csv$",
                              full.names = TRUE)

perry_fp_path <- perry_fp_files[which.max(file.mtime(perry_fp_files))]
perry_fp <- read.csv(perry_fp_path)

# Build per-pedon truth for Perry (most-frequent rule, matching modeling pipeline)
build_truth <- function(df, col) {
  if (!col %in% names(df)) return(tibble(peiid = character(), truth = character()))
  dat <- df %>%
    mutate(truth_val = na_if(str_squish(as.character(.data[[col]])), ""),
           peiid = as.character(Point))
  if (col == "taxpartsize") dat <- dat %>% mutate(truth_val = str_to_lower(truth_val))
  if (col == "series_clean") {
    dat <- dat %>% mutate(truth_val = na_if(truth_val, "Fill"),
                          truth_val = str_to_title(truth_val))
  }
  dat %>%
    group_by(peiid) %>%
    summarise(
      truth = {
        nv <- truth_val[!is.na(truth_val)]
        if (length(nv) == 0) NA_character_ else
          names(sort(table(nv), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# Define what we want and where it lives
outcome_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~outcome,           ~ncss_col,         ~perry_col,
  "taxorder",         "taxorder",        "taxorder",
  "taxsuborder",      "taxsuborder",     "taxsuborder",
  "taxgrtgroup",      "taxgrtgroup",     "taxgrtgroup",
  "taxsubgrp_mod1",   "taxsubgrp_mod1",  "taxsubgrp_mod1",
  "taxpartsize",      "taxpartsize",     "taxpartsize",
  "taxonname_clean",  "taxonname_clean", "series_clean"
)

# Long-format class counts: outcome x dataset x class -> n
class_counts <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(outcome_map)), function(i) {
  oc <- outcome_map$outcome[i]
  ncss_col <- outcome_map$ncss_col[i]
  perry_col <- outcome_map$perry_col[i]

  ncss_part <- if (ncss_col %in% names(ncss)) {
    ncss %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[ncss_col]])) %>%
      mutate(class = as.character(.data[[ncss_col]])) %>%
      count(class) %>%
      mutate(dataset = "NCSS", outcome = oc)
  } else NULL

  perry_truth <- build_truth(perry_fp, perry_col)
  perry_part <- if (nrow(perry_truth) > 0) {
    perry_truth %>%
      filter(!is.na(truth)) %>%
      count(truth) %>%
      rename(class = truth) %>%
      mutate(dataset = "Perry", outcome = oc)
  } else NULL

  bind_rows(ncss_part, perry_part)
})

# Standardize taxpartsize case
class_counts <- class_counts %>%
  mutate(class = if_else(outcome == "taxpartsize", str_to_lower(class), class))
```

```{r master-fig-1-class-distributions}
# ============================================================
# MASTER FIGURE 1: Class distributions, NCSS vs Perry
# Faceted by outcome, top-N classes per outcome
# ============================================================

# For each outcome, take top 10 classes by total count across both datasets
top_classes <- class_counts %>%
  group_by(outcome, class) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(outcome) %>%
  slice_max(total, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(outcome, class)

class_plot_data <- class_counts %>%
  semi_join(top_classes, by = c("outcome", "class")) %>%
  mutate(
    outcome = factor(outcome,
                     levels = c("taxorder", "taxsuborder", "taxgrtgroup",
                                "taxsubgrp_mod1", "taxpartsize", "taxonname_clean"),
                     labels = c("Order", "Suborder", "Great Group",
                                "Subgroup", "Particle Size", "Series (top 10)")),
    dataset = factor(dataset, levels = c("NCSS", "Perry"))
  )

# Order classes within each facet by total count
class_plot_data <- class_plot_data %>%
  group_by(outcome, class) %>%
  mutate(facet_total = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(outcome, desc(facet_total)) %>%
  group_by(outcome) %>%
  mutate(class = factor(class, levels = unique(class))) %>%
  ungroup()

master_fig1 <- ggplot(class_plot_data,
                      aes(x = class, y = n, fill = dataset)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
            vjust = -0.3, size = 2.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ outcome, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ds_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of pedons",
       title = "Class distributions across taxonomic levels: NCSS vs Perry",
       subtitle = "NCSS = full Coastal Plain training set; Perry = Georgia agricultural field") +
  thesis_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1, size = 9))

print(master_fig1)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "master_fig1_class_distributions.png"),
       master_fig1, width = 13, height = 11, dpi = 300)
```

```{r master-fig-2-feature-distributions}
# ============================================================
# MASTER FIGURE 2: Feature distributions, NCSS vs Perry
# Density plots for key continuous predictors
# ============================================================

# Pick the predictors that matter most for taxonomic distinctions
key_features <- tibble::tribble(
  ~feature,                ~label,                          ~category,
  "clay_w",                "Clay (%)",                      "Texture",
  "sand_w",                "Sand (%)",                      "Texture",
  "silt_w",                "Silt (%)",                      "Texture",
  "R_w",                   "Red channel (RGB)",             "Color",
  "G_w",                   "Green channel (RGB)",           "Color",
  "B_w",                   "Blue channel (RGB)",            "Color",
  "depth_to_Bt_cm",        "Depth to Bt (cm)",              "Morphology",
  "bt_thickness_cm",       "Bt thickness (cm)",             "Morphology",
  "max_clay_ratio_0_150",  "Max clay ratio (0–150 cm)",     "Argillic",
  "max_clay_delta_0_150",  "Max clay delta (0–150 cm)",     "Argillic",
  "depth_to_argillic_cm",  "Depth to argillic (cm)",        "Argillic",
  "argillic_thickness_cm", "Argillic thickness (cm)",       "Argillic"
)

# Verify all features exist in both datasets
missing <- setdiff(key_features$feature, intersect(names(ncss), names(perry)))
if (length(missing) > 0) {
  cat("WARNING: features missing from one dataset:", paste(missing, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  key_features <- key_features %>% filter(!feature %in% missing)
}

feat_long <- both %>%
  select(dataset, all_of(key_features$feature)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -dataset, names_to = "feature", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value), is.finite(value)) %>%
  left_join(key_features, by = "feature") %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = key_features$label))

master_fig2 <- ggplot(feat_long, aes(x = value, fill = dataset, color = dataset)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ label, scales = "free", ncol = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ds_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_color_manual(values = ds_colors, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Density",
       title = "Feature distributions: NCSS vs Perry",
       subtitle = "Domain shift visible in clay translocation, color, and Bt morphology") +
  thesis_theme +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 9.5))

print(master_fig2)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "master_fig2_feature_distributions.png"),
       master_fig2, width = 14, height = 9, dpi = 300)
```

```{r missingness-summary}
# ============================================================
# Missingness comparison: which features are missing where
# ============================================================

# Just continuous features (skip prop_hzbase_* — they're sparse by design)
candidate_features <- key_features$feature
chemistry_features <- c("cec7_w", "pct_hz_with_cec7",
                        "min_cec_per_kg_clay_0_150",
                        "median_cec_per_kg_clay_bt_zone")

all_check <- c(candidate_features, chemistry_features)
all_check <- intersect(all_check, intersect(names(ncss), names(perry)))

missingness <- map_dfr(all_check, function(f) {
  tibble(
    feature = f,
    pct_missing_NCSS = round(100 * mean(is.na(ncss[[f]])), 1),
    pct_missing_Perry = round(100 * mean(is.na(perry[[f]])), 1)
  )
}) %>%
  arrange(desc(pmax(pct_missing_NCSS, pct_missing_Perry)))

print(missingness, n = Inf)
write.csv(missingness, file.path(fig_dir, "missingness_comparison.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r summary-stats-table}
# ============================================================
# Summary statistics: median ± IQR for each feature, per dataset
# ============================================================

summary_stats <- both %>%
  select(dataset, all_of(key_features$feature)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-dataset, names_to = "feature", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value), is.finite(value)) %>%
  group_by(feature, dataset) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median = round(median(value), 2),
    q25 = round(quantile(value, 0.25), 2),
    q75 = round(quantile(value, 0.75), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = dataset,
    values_from = c(n, median, q25, q75),
    names_glue = "{dataset}_{.value}"
  ) %>%
  left_join(key_features %>% select(feature, label, category), by = "feature") %>%
  select(category, feature, label, everything()) %>%
  arrange(category, feature)

print(summary_stats, n = Inf)
write.csv(summary_stats, file.path(fig_dir, "feature_summary_stats.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r feature-differences}
# ============================================================
# Quantitative summary of distributional differences
# Median shift between Perry and NCSS for each continuous predictor
# ============================================================

median_shifts <- both %>%
  select(dataset, all_of(key_features$feature)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-dataset, names_to = "feature", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value), is.finite(value)) %>%
  group_by(feature, dataset) %>%
  summarise(median_val = median(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = dataset, values_from = median_val,
              names_prefix = "median_") %>%
  mutate(
    median_shift = median_Perry - median_NCSS,
    abs_shift = abs(median_shift)
  ) %>%
  left_join(key_features %>% select(feature, label, category),
            by = "feature") %>%
  select(category, feature, label, median_NCSS, median_Perry,
         median_shift, abs_shift) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_shift))

print(median_shifts, n = Inf)
write.csv(median_shifts,
          here("outputs", "figures_05_02", "eda", "median_shifts.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```
